We collect human attention maps for the Yelp dataset on the classification task of rating a review as positive or negative on Amazon Mechanical Turk. Participants are asked to complete two tasks: 1) Identify the sentiment of the review as positive, negative, or neither, and 2) Highlight the words that are indicative of the chosen sentiment.
guideline: Annotators first determine the sentiment (positive, negative, or neither) and then select the words that indicate that sentiment.
